text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Today's mixer is a place for new and 
upperclass students to mingle without any 
barriers."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
New students, there is no need to hold 
back. This is an opportunity for mutual 
learning, so feel free to interact as you 
wish.

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text: Y... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Feel free to call out to whoever you'd 
like to hear from. Do you have any 
questions for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Total silence......)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
In that case... anyone who wants to know 
the trendiest spots nearby, touch my 
finger!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you in on the hottest discos and 
the tastiest Italian restaurants loved by 
all the hip young folks~☆

text_block_list.name: Freshman A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So we can ask that kind of question 
too...! Maruzen-senpai! Please tell us--!!

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text:
I-I want to talk to CB-senpai! 
CB-senpaaaai~~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Looks like the new students have 
finally relaxed. Let's leave this to 
Maruzensky and the others.

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing CB-senpai's race back then made 
me want to run with her someday! That's 
why I entered Tracen Academy!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Heh... In that case, let's go for a run 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Right now...? B-But... I'm not good 
enough to run with you yet, Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Passing up a chance? That's not good. 
There's no guarantee the opportunity will 
come around again, you know.

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's true, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, since you're running anyway, 
wouldn't you prefer a good contest?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then how about a relay format? If we team 
up upperclassmen with freshmen, it should 
make for a good match."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! Doesn't that make you want to 
run too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're on my team, okay! We're gonna 
challenge CB-chan and win♪

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much!! I get to run with 
CB-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've already obtained permission to use 
the grounds. Hehe, I had a feeling someone 
would ask to run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Is it because Rudolf agrees with your 
assessment? Naturally, I'm running!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...If there are any new students willing 
to join my team—"

text_block_list.name: Freshman C
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! I-If it's no trouble, I want to run 
the relay... with President Rudolf!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever consider it a bother? 
Don't worry, there is no father here who 
will berate you for dropping the baton. 
...Fufu.
